This matches the exact monoisotopic mass of a neutral molecule with formula C₆H₁₀O₂ (12 × 6 + 1.007825 × 10 + 15.994915 × 2 = 114.06808). The formula gives an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 2), so it is chemically plausible. No other elements are indicated, so X is omitted.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H10O2</final_answer>
